function.description: Update the active Resident task only when interpretation, requirements or working state changes. working saves focus/next_move and optionally replaces the plan; refine sets interpretation/requirements only in the goal's origin turn; revise changes requirements using the current user turn ID and an exact quote from that message. Replace example turn IDs with actual IDs from the active Goal; each requirement must cite the origin or current user turn. Working items record a revisable plan, not user requirements. Keep the plan consistent with actual results and remaining content gaps before finishing. Success returns {goal_id, revision, changed}; changed=false means no state change. This tool cannot mark delivery or Goal completion; completed items do not prove either. Short direct answers need no update or plan. Use working in a separate call to save focus, next_move or plan items; refine/revise do not accept these fields.
function.name: goal_update

items.description: For operation=working: replace the whole ordered work plan atomically. Omit to retain it; [] clears it. Use non-empty unique IDs and non-empty descriptions. Reorder, split, merge, remove abandoned steps or reopen completed items as observations require; this does not change requirements.

verification.description: content: explanation correctness and features inside the authored page, including page controls, dragging, playback, pause, seeking and saved scene restoration. presentation_delivery: actually save and deliver the requested page. reader_action: an explicitly requested host Reader operation such as navigating the book or changing its panels; requires an actual Reader effect. Page interactions and preview actions are content requirements, not reader_action. Keep the user's required behavior in description; choose verification by what must actually be delivered.

function.description: Save the user's requested note text at a verified source lid. The lid is the note's body placement; text is the content to retain, not a highlight quote. Use this tool for notes, including requested summaries of an explanation; memory.save cannot create notes. Success returns {ok:true,note_id,status:CREATED|EXISTING}; note_id is the persisted memory ID. EXISTING reuses the same note rather than creating another. New Agent notes are saved in the session layer. If reader_effect.status=not_applied, the note is saved but Reader selection did not apply. Replace the example lid with the actual requested location. Do not create a note for an explanation-only request or claim success before the receipt.
function.name: reader_note

function.description: Save a user-requested source highlight at a verified LID. For a sentence, pass the exact unique quote within that LID; omit quote only for the whole passage. This interface accepts one lid and an optional quote, not offsets, an end_lid or note text. Use reader.note for commentary. Success returns {ok:true,highlight_id}, the saved session memory ID. If reader_effect.status=not_applied, persistence succeeded but the Reader selection did not apply. Replace example locations and quotes with observed source text; an explanation alone needs no highlight.
function.name: reader_highlight

quote.description: Exact requested original text within this LID; must match once

function.description: Save an existing reader fact at a verified anchor_lid. type=highlight stores supplied content as long_term memory without resolving a source range or selecting it in Reader; use reader.highlight for a requested source highlight. position stores a session reading-position memory, without navigating. qa stores the user's original substantive question after answering with book.query, not the generated answer or routine chat history. context stores sourced reader background, preferences, interests or sticking points; retain what the user actually said and distinguish inference. Use reader.note for every note. context needs no book citation for a user-stated preference; citations may contain real supporting LIDs, and invalid LIDs are dropped. Success returns the saved record {mem_id,type,layer,anchor,content,citations,...}; it is not a note_id or proof of learning. Replace example locations and content with observed facts; do not write merely to explain selected text.
function.name: memory_save
